talentName: Sage Jutsu Shadow Clone / Sage Jutsu Chakra
talentDesc: Summons the clone at battle start and grants 20 Chakra before the first action of each round. Talents have no cooldown.

talentName: Senjutsu Power / Tale of Jiraiya the Gallant
talentDesc: Prompt. Chakra 20; cooldown 3 rounds; battlefield cooldown 0. Consumes the primary action. Toad Esophagus for 2 rounds: barrier creators/destroyers on both sides cannot cast Mystery. Immediately casts Toad Confrontation Chant. Damage up to 2 enemies. Suppress Immunity and apply Extreme Chaos for the hit round only. Targets are protected against another Toad Chant control through the next round. Cooldown 2 rounds. Uses the primary action; waits while recovering. Unavoidable lineup damage, 5 COMBO. Stackable -10% Resistance. High chance (local: 70%) of Knockdown to selected target. Cooldown 2 rounds; cannot be bypassed by Chase bonuses. At least 15 COMBO. Damage up to 4 enemies, Repulse to selected target. +1 Chase limit for allies without Chase cooldowns this round, non-stacking. Round start: restore chakra limit to 100; +2% team Initiative each round, up to 10%. Cleanse Jiraiya and up to 2 other Senjutsu allies; +20 shared chakra for each. After defeat, revive at 30% HP after allies cast 3 Mysteries. Preserves cooldowns and cannot act again in the revival round.

Two Standards every round. Once per battle below 50% HP: enter Rage and recover 50% max HP. Rage grants enhanced Mystery, Standards and Chases, 12% Life Steal, enhanced Kamui at the beginning of every round (no cooldown) and one additional Standard after defeating an enemy with a Standard. Triggered at 20 Combo: damage up to 7 enemies and absorb 20 shared chakra per hit enemy. Once per round. No cooldown. Per-round Chase limits still apply. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Chase Low Float: consumes 5% max HP, damages all enemies in the same line, causes Knockdown, Immobile for 1 round and Level 2 Kamui Tag. Ignores a portion of Defense and Resistance. Once per round. No cooldown. Per-round Chase limits still apply. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Rage 20 Combo Chase: damage up to 7 enemies; Suppress Immunity for 1 round; absorb 20 chakra per hit enemy. Once per round. No cooldown. Per-round Chase limits still apply. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Rage Chase Low Float: no HP cost; damage all enemies in the same line, Knockdown, Immobile for 1 round and Level 2 Kamui Tag. Ignores a portion of Defense and Resistance. Twice per round. No cooldown. Per-round Chase limits still apply. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Rage Mystery. Damage all enemies, Low Float to selected target; +40% Chase damage until round end (does not stack). Chakra 40, reduced by 20 after each use to minimum 0. Cooldown 3 rounds, battlefield cooldown 0. Prompt; does not consume a Standard. Local automatic combat casts at most once per round. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Outer Path / The One called God / Shurado - Laser Canon
talentDesc: Prompt. Consume 1 Technique Point and 20 Chakra. Damage and Interruption to up to 7 enemies. Selected target: Horror II and Mystery Chakra Cost +20 (stackable) through round end. Cooldown 2 rounds; battlefield cooldown 0. Below 60% HP becomes Extreme - Almighty Push. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Consume all Technique Points and 20 Chakra. Damage, 5 Combo and Interruption to all enemies; selected target: Repulse, Horror II, Mystery Chakra Cost +20 (stackable) through round end. Cooldown 3 rounds; battlefield cooldown 0. 7% Life Steal. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Final Mystery. Consume 2 Technique Points, Chakra 0, cooldown 2 rounds (up to two casts in an eligible round), battlefield cooldown 0. Unavoidable damage, 5 Combo and Interruption to all enemies; selected target: Repulse, Horror II and Mystery Chakra Cost +20 (stackable) through round end. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Attack up to 6 enemies, causes 4 Combo, reduces own Mystery cooldown by 1 and gains 1 Technique Point. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. No cooldown. Chase Repulse or Knockdown. Causes Knockdown, Chakra Disruption II and Pain II; target Chakra Limit becomes 20 through round end. Causes 30% splash damage to units 1 grid away. Never misses; ignores part of Defense/Resistance. Chakra Disruption II: Attack/Ninjutsu -10% per opposing Rinnegan ninja through next round end. Pain II: Defense/Resistance suppressed to 75% of base stats; lose 10% current HP on every Standard through next round end. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. No cooldown. At the beginning of every round, unleash a massive laser across ALL enemies in every row and remove 10 Chakra per hit unit. Gain 1 Technique Point; immune to Interruption for the round. Allied Rinnegan ninjas have unavoidable Mysteries through round end. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Outer Path - Six Paths of Pain: up to 5 Technique Points, each increases Attack and Ninjutsu by 12%. Gain 0.5 point whenever attacked. First defeat per battle: revive with 100% HP, lose ALL current skills, gain ONLY Final - Almighty Push and Final - The One called God. Final - The One called God: Super Armor and immune to Debuffs; up to 2 Mysteries per round. Up to 5 Technique Points; Attack and Ninjutsu +20% per point. Gain 1 point whenever attacked. Critical Hits increase hit target Mystery Chakra Cost by 20. Once per battle, if another allied ninja is defeated, revive at 40% HP and trigger Super - Almighty Push. Triggered after Final revival. Unavoidable damage, 5 Combo and Interruption to all enemies. All enemies Mystery Chakra Cost +20 (stackable) through round end. Does not consume Technique Points or Chakra. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. The One called God: every damage event scales Attack by 12%; Critical Hits inflict Chakra Disruption II. Cancel incoming Debuffs except Level 2; each cancellation increases Initiative by 2%, stacking up to 5. Horror II (Fear): cannot Standard Attack or receive external Buffs, stat increases or Shields until next round end or the affected unit executes a Mystery.

talentName: Chakra Burst / Senjutsu Power / Advent of a World of Flowering Trees
talentDesc: Chakra Burst: first damage each round grants Excited Mode (Attack/Ninjutsu +60%, Defense/Resistance -30%) through round end. Each damage event grants 0.5 Technique Point (max 2); Defense +20% per point. At 2 points consume all, recover 40 Chakra, enter Burst. Base Senjutsu: immune to Debuffs, heal 25% max HP and Mystery cooldown -1 whenever damaged. Burst: advanced immunity, Fire immunity, +30% damage, defense penetration on Chases; living Burst Hashirama grants allies +3% Attack/Ninjutsu stacks whenever they deal respective damage. Each activation and deactivation of Burst adds permanent stacking +10% Mystery damage. End of round: leave Burst, activate Deep Forest and Explosive Mode for 2 rounds. Under the forest, Explosive units using Mysteries inflict Root Binding II on hit targets for the round (cannot Standard, Defense/Resistance fixed to 100% base). Deity Gate Seal II: cannot Mystery, guaranteed Critical Hits locked to 1.5x for the round. Weakness II: Attack/Ninjutsu fixed to 75% base through stated duration. Any formation position. Mysteries: 3/2 round recovery, Chakra 20/40; Chase twice per round; additional skill once per round. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Orochimaru's Advance Technology / Mecha-Naruto - Jet / Tailed Beast Mode
talentDesc: Immune to Debuffs. Each executed action grants +8% Critical Rate and +15% Physical ATK, up to 6 triggers per round; growth persists through battle. Jet has a high chance to evade one ordinary attack per round and a 45% chance to evade Chases. On evade, recover 20 Chakra and trigger Extreme Beam, up to 3 times per round, even while controlled. Any formation position. Unspecified high chances are configured as 60%. After Chakra Bomb, permanently replace all base skills with Tailed Beast Mode: Energy Recovery (Mystery), additional Chakra Bomb, even-round Claw Strike and odd-round Tail Sweep; no base Standards, Rasengan, Jet or Technology triggers remain. Super Armor and Debuff immunity. Each Kurama Trigger grants +20% Physical ATK, stacking. Attacks received reduce Mystery recovery by 1. Energy Recovery activates permanent Explosive Mode: damaging enemies gain up to four Inflammation stacks; each physical action costs them 1% max HP per stack. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Sho - Gyoku / Rei - Byaku / San - Hoku / Akatsuki Leader / Crow Clone Jutsu
talentDesc: The first two Mystery, Trigger and Standard Attack damage instances received each round are reduced by 50%, triggering Deidara/Sasori, Pain/Konan or Hidan/Kakuzu respectively. Clears Ignition when attacked by Mystery, Fear/Discouragement when attacked by Trigger. Cancels incoming debuffs including Level 2 and grants Hiding. Critical damage grants +8% Critical Rate and heals 15% max HP, up to five times per round. While alive, attacks damaging allied Akatsuki suppress attacker immunity (Ninjutsu) or Super Armor (Taijutsu). Evading grants +12% Physical ATK up to seven times per round. Crow Clone Jutsu activates after an allied Akatsuki first action each round, greatly increasing chase evasion; chase damage grants +20% DEF/Resistance up to 100% for the round. SSS; any formation position. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: The Two Great Visual Jutsu / Susanoo - Dominance
talentDesc: Melee swordsman. Super Armor and debuff immunity. Two Mysteries per round; first two Mystery attacks received are reduced by 40%, first two pure Taijutsu attacks deal no damage. While alive, grants team +18% attack scaling and +7% critical rate when executing skills. Amaterasu Blaze: attacks shred own ATK/Ninjutsu 1%; damage received shreds own DEF/Resistance 2%, through next round. Electrocution suppresses 75% of Resistance this round. Disorder: first critical hit each round reduces attacker critical rate by 15% and stores 10% max-HP damage for round end. Extreme Fear blocks standards and buffs and deals 5% current HP per action (cap 3000) at round end. Static applies Level 2 Paralysis on Trigger actions, or teamwide on Mystery. All damaging actions hit all targets and use Physical ATK/DEF. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
